task: As the marketing lead, I need to set up a new email campaign for our upcoming 'AI for Beginners' course. I'll create a new list, add some existing leads, design a promotional email using a template, and schedule it. Then, I'll segment this list based on engagement and set up a simple automation for new sign-ups, finally reviewing the campaign's performance metrics.

observations.what: After the email verification link, a two-page 'complete account' wizard required a street address (for email footers) before the app opened. Several app loads showed 'GetResponse is loading...' or a blank spinner for 10-20 seconds and timed out the 20-30s page loads.
Creating a list took only two actions: Create list, then type a name in a modal and click Create. The new list then appeared in the table with its creation date and contact count.

The Contacts area groups Lists, Search, Segments (beta), Reports, List hygiene, Suppression lists, Custom fields, Import statistics and Tags as tabs on one page, and it shows a clear free-plan meter ('limit of 500 contacts, 499 more').
The Lists page shifted down by about 70px after the plan-limit banner loaded, so my first click on Create list landed on empty space.

'Add contacts' opens a chooser (One by one / From file / Via integration / Via signup form). After I picked 'One by one', the chooser closed and the form opened only seconds later. Adding a contact manually also needs a list dropdown, email, name and a consent checkbox, which is about five actions per contact, with 'Save and add another' as the only batch help.
The manual add form lets you put a contact into an autoresponder cycle with a toggle and add custom fields inline, so you can tag leads for a course launch while entering them.

There are no top-level links to email, automation or campaigns: the header shows only Tools, Contacts and Reports. Everything else sits inside a 21-item Tools mega-menu, alongside courses, webinars, ads and the website builder.
Automation offers Workflows, Automation messages and Events tabs, with a Create workflow entry point that advertises templates for onboarding, sales and retention, and the trial unlocks it.

The session harness refused to let me type the made-up lead email demo.alpha@example.com (it allows only the sign-up identity email), so I could not add the demo leads. This is a harness limit, not a product fact.

I wasted steps by guessing a 404 URL (/email-marketing). Early on I also used a shared scratch args file, so one click went to another agent's session. I ran out of steps before the email template, scheduling, segments, automation build and reports.
